title: UNION-PROFILE-HOME: are the 39 order-reliable union strata or the 14 MMLU-Pro anchors the profile's home? (the numbers the author's question 3 needs)
question: On the union pool paeec37aa28063c75 (6,482 reserved q, 52 designed strata, 18-model key): interaction-only reliability WITH an interval on the 52 / 39 / 14 objects, coverage of the pool by the order-reliable strata, and per order-reliable stratum whether the key's undominated set differs from its source's.

criteria.text: the 52-stratum interaction-only R reproduces 0.8537 to 4 dp (the gate)
the 39-stratum interaction-only R with its jackknife interval is PUBLISHED (class PASS if the lower bound >= 0.70)
the 14 MMLU_PRO_LB strata's interaction-only R with interval PUBLISHED beside K12 / K46, rosters and pools named, no level claim
criteria.value: 0.6814 [0.5613, 0.8014] (18-model union roster, 3,609 reserved MMLU-Pro q) beside K12 0.8665 [0.8000, 0.9330] / K46 0.8118 [0.7254, 0.8983] (p2dca, 2,811 judged q); no level claim

criteria.text: HOME COUNT: the number of the 39 order-reliable strata whose undominated set differs from its source's

plain_description.what: On the six-corpus union pool (6,482 questions, 18 models), it measures how reliably each designed stratum orders models. For each reliable stratum it then checks whether the set of best models differs from its source corpus's set. No calls.
plain_description.why: It decides whether the per-cell model profile lives best on the 39 union strata or on the 14 MMLU-Pro categories.
plain_description.information: It answers which object the profile should be built on. Result: the 39 strata are reliable (0.865), while the 14 MMLU-Pro categories are less so (0.68). The best set differs from the source's in 36 of 39 strata, but in 28 of these the set is only larger, a power effect. A real routing consequence shows in only 8 strata. Which object the paper leads with stays the author's choice. Answer keys only. Caveat disclosed later: the union tree used leaks some evaluation questions into training.
